defs.def: without the help of other people or things 独力；单独

ex.s: While the adults were busy with their serious talk outside, I was left alone in the ____21____ to help my grandmother wash dishes. ____22____ my grandmother would tell me stories about her childhood.

defs.def: lonely and unhappy or without any friends 孤苦伶仃；无依无靠；孤独；寂寞

ex.s: Recent studies estimate that between 400 million and 1 billion birds die from window impacts each year in the US alone.
ex.t: 最近的研究估计，仅在美国，每年就有4亿至10亿只鸟死于窗户撞击。

defs.def: （用于名词或代词后）唯一，只有

ex.s: If you want to tell the history of the whole world, a history that does not privilege one part of humanity, you cannot do it through texts alone, because only some of the world has ever had texts, while most of the world, for most of the time, has not.
ex.t: 如果你想讲述全世界的历史，一段不偏袒人类某一部分的历史，你无法仅靠文本来完成，因为世界上只有部分地区曾有过文本，而大部分地区在大多数时间里并没有。

defs.def: （用于名词或代词后以加强语气）仅仅，单，只
to be independent or not connected with other people, organizations or ideas 单独；独立

ex.s: Phil Blythe explains: “For many older people, particularly those living alone or in the country, driving is important for preserving their independence, giving them the freedom to get out and about without having to rely on others.”
ex.t: 菲尔·布莱思解释道：“对许多老年人，尤其是独居或住在乡下的人，开车对保持他们的独立性很重要，让他们能自由外出，不必依赖别人。”
